bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
# Exit code 10 local Bot API missing, 20 large MP4 missing, 30 both missing.
api=0; media=0
if (pgrep -af '[/]telegram-bot-api' | grep -q .) || (docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q 'telegram-bot-api'); then api=1; fi
if find /mnt/g /mnt/G /home/gace/Project/Gserver -type f -iname '*.mp4' -size +1000M -print -quit 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then media=1; fi
if [ "$api" -eq 0 ] && [ "$media" -eq 0 ]; then exit 30; fi
if [ "$api" -eq 0 ]; then exit 10; fi
if [ "$media" -eq 0 ]; then exit 20; fi
printf 'LOCAL_API_AND_LARGE_MP4_PRESENT\n'
